To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1) the professionalization of public relations in the British media has been a major factor in changing the patterns of source access to news; 2) this process is affecting all types of sources, although in different ways; 3) the process is not necessarily a negative one for all sources, as it is providing new opportunities for some to gain access to media; and 4) there is a need for further research to explore the implications of these changes in greater detail.
The British national media have become increasingly dependent on public relations information and the professional public relations industry has grown rapidly as a result.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the following questions: How are professional public relations organizations affecting existing patterns of media source access?
the following questions: What are the implications of these changes for media-source relations?
the changing nature and role of public relations, the impact of this on the news production process and how this in turn affects source access to news media in Britain.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
public relations has become a major force in British news production and is having an impact on the way in which various sources are attempting to gain and manage access to the media.
public relations is a means by which organizations of all kinds are attempting to secure access advantages and is also providing new opportunities for non-official sources.
the public relations industry, and its associated practices, is a major influence on the British national news agenda.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the public relations sector is becoming increasingly influential in the process of national media production, but that the effects of this on the media's ability to provide balanced and diverse news are still uncertain.
PR is an effective means for organizations and individuals to manage their public image and gain access to news outlets.
the rise of public relations is having a major effect on media-source relations, but that the effect is not uniform.
The main takeaway from our work is that
public relations has become a major factor in the production and consumption of news.

, although the professional PR industry has grown rapidly in recent years and is now a significant source of news information in the UK, the influence of public relations is still limited by the fact that most journalists still rely on their own networks of contacts for news.
public relations is not only an increasingly significant factor in the production of news, but also a factor that is changing the nature of the relationship between news producers and their sources.
